capabilities: copy the active note as a [[wikilink]]
copy a highlighted result from search-style modals as a wikilink
read selected file paths from Omnisearch result rows
best-effort copy from Quick Switcher and Better Command Palette results
run via command palette or Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C
extras: README warns that copying from search modals depends on result markup in the modal DOM, so third-party search plugins that change markup may break support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to copy the current note or a selected search result to the clipboard as a wikilink.

relations.evidence: Includes support for Omnisearch result rows that expose a selected file path.
Includes best-effort support for Quick Switcher and Better Command Palette style results.

summary: Command and hotkey that copies the active note, or a highlighted search-modal result, to the clipboard as a wikilink like [[My note]].
